title: Retrieve design-specific ERD changes and their implementation context
preconditions: Disposable format-2 Saga using the PDF inventory fixture: implemented PDF report held by Record store, proposed JSON PDF job held by Job queue, report-to-job production relationship, application ERD, and pdf-jobs overlay; the reporting ERD also includes a job association with owner 0..many and destination unknown.

Prepare a committed baseline and selected design with an added code-free entity, an edited relationship and an unrelated proposal in another feature; record exact design, feature, baseline and head identities.

steps.action: Use public inventory/whiteboard queries for the selected design or named comparison and inspect added/changed entities and relationships.
steps.expected_result: Both entity additions and relationship edits are discoverable with stable identities even without code evidence.

steps.action: Restrict the proposed results to the selected design/feature and inspect declared scope paths.
steps.expected_result: Related entities and relationships are returned with the declared links proving scope; unrelated proposals are excluded.

steps.action: Follow each returned design pin and current evidence link.
steps.expected_result: The committed design remains readable and required work, existing implementation and unresolved knowledge are distinguishable.
